title: Cabbage and Cheese Pie
subtitle: baked with three cheeses
description: A savoury pie of fried cabbage and onion baked in a cottage cheese and sour cream custard with melted cheese, served with a yoghurt dip.

steps.text: Slice the onion and cabbage into thin strips.
Heat olive oil in a wide frying pan and fry the onion until golden. Add the cabbage and a little salt and fry, stirring, for about 15 minutes until soft and reduced. Let it cool slightly.
In a bowl, mix the eggs, cottage cheese, sour cream, the cheeses (keeping some tasty cheese for the top), flour and baking powder. Season with salt, pepper and onion soup powder.
Add the cabbage and onion and mix well.
Transfer to a greased baking dish, sprinkle a little tasty cheese on top and bake for 40-50 minutes, until golden and set.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting. Meanwhile, prepare the yoghurt and cucumber dip.
Serve the pie with the yoghurt.
